Devastate
Talent
15 RageMelee Range
Instant cast
Requires Warrior
Requires level 60
Requires One-Handed Melee Weapon
Sunder the target's armor causing the Sunder Armor effect.  In addition, causes 50% of weapon damage plus 25 for each application of Sunder Armor on the target.  The Sunder Armor effect can stack up to 5 times.
